hero.headline: When migration strikes, the world can feel colder and more hostile.
hero.subheadline: Emotional and psychological support to help you recover calm and resilience.
hero.intro: I'm Romina Méndez, a psychotherapist with over 10 years of clinical experience. I provide psychotherapy in your language: Spanish, English, or Italian.

empathy.text: The courage it takes to go through migration and the sadness of acknowledging a loss don't mean overlooking your own vulnerability.
empathy.text2: Being strong doesn't mean handling everything alone or feeling less.

about.title: My journey
about.bio_1: I have been living far from my hometown since 2006 and I know firsthand the experience of missing loved ones, places, and ways of being in the world.
about.bio_2: Migration transforms identity; there is a daily, hard-to-define loss.
about.bio_3: Through Acceptance and Commitment Therapy (ACT), I accompany you in exploring your current experience of grief and/or migration. Building a life that feels meaningful and valuable is possible beyond suffering and pain.
about.bio_4: I incorporate cognitive-behavioral and systemic therapy techniques that help you identify dysfunctional behavioral patterns and facilitate decision-making that generates real change.
about.credentials_subtitle: Rigorous training and international specialization to offer you high-quality clinical support.

services.title: Online care, without geographical barriers, adapted to your time zone.
services.subtitle: Available in English, Spanish, and Italian.
services.individual_desc: Begin transforming your relationship with pain and rediscover a sense of value in your life.
services.couple_desc: Rebuild connection during times of change, from a place of compassion and reciprocity.

services.workshop_desc_professionals: Professionals: If you're looking for a career change, build new skills in job searching through LinkedIn.
